ticketSource._comment: Where tickets are read from and test cases are written back to. `none` is the default and needs no credentials or MCP — the full pipeline runs against a local markdown ticket and writes test cases to disk. Switch to your tracker once the pipeline works. Per-source API recipes live in .claude/guides/ticket-sources.md; only that guide and fetch-ticket.md/post-tests.md know how a tracker works.

jira._comment: Requires the Atlassian MCP connection. cloudId may be your site domain or the UUID — fetch-ticket resolves a domain to a UUID automatically.

github._comment: Uses the gh CLI — no MCP needed. Verify with `gh auth status`.

azure._comment: PAT is read from the named env var and never written to disk. Needs the `Work Items: Read & Write` scope.

jira._comment: DEPRECATED — moved to ticketSource.jira. Kept so pre-1.0 configs keep working: commands read ticketSource.jira first and fall back here. Delete this block once ticketSource.jira is filled in.

auth._comment: primary = your main app under test. If your suite tests a second backend, replace `secondary: null` with a block of the same shape (loginCommand, sessionCookieAlias, csrfTokenAlias). The flattened keys below are the default when a spec doesn't say which app it targets.

app._comment: Used by explore-live-app.md for browser-driven exploration. baseUrls should mirror the environments in your test-runner config; credentials are read from envFile, never hardcoded. Set secondaryBaseUrl only if you test a second backend.
app._allowedHostsComment: Extra hosts (staging/uat) the browser MCP may reach besides localhost and the baseUrl hosts — enforced by .claude/hooks/block-risky-mcp.sh.

testLimits._comment: Per SPEC FILE targets — multi-layer tickets get multiple spec files instead of dropped coverage (see create-ui-automated-test-cases.md)

runCommand._comment: {specFile} and {env} are replaced at runtime by run-tests.md. Add any environment prefix your machine needs (e.g. a Node version manager) to all three commands.

productionProtection._comment: Regex patterns that must never appear in a shell command (block-risky-bash.sh) or a browser navigation URL (block-risky-mcp.sh). Put your production hostnames here.

productCode._comment: rootPaths MUST be overridden in .claude/project-config.local.json with your local repo paths
productCode._stackComment: Selects the route/handler/model/role-gate search patterns /analyze-code uses. Valid keys are the top-level keys of .claude/stacks/code-patterns.json: go-chi, go-gin, express, nestjs, django, fastapi, rails, spring-boot, laravel, dotnet, generic. `generic` works but is noisy — set your real stack. If your framework is missing, add a key to code-patterns.json; never edit analyze-code.md.

codePatterns._comment: Optional per-project overrides merged OVER the selected stack preset, field by field. Use this for in-house route helpers the preset cannot know about, e.g. "route": ["registerInternalRoute"]. Leave empty to use the preset as-is.

productCode._sourceGlobsComment: Empty = inherit sourceGlobs from the selected stack preset. Set explicitly only to override.

postman._comment: Describe your app's real auth flow here so generated collections model it correctly (cookie vs bearer, where the CSRF token comes from). See cypress/support/commands.js in your repo for the source of truth.
